meta.purpose: Preserve the user's forecast theory, controls and reverse-calculation logic as an explicit reference layer for the live 2W model. Live actuals remain governed by SIOMAA/CAFAM and Pivot/Registrations.

validation.note: BACKTEST sheet metrics. The presentation conclusion also displays a later 10.43% MAPE figure; preserve both as source-version history rather than silently merging them.

calibration.live_formula_source: SCENARIO ASSUMPTIONS!C6 -> FCST COMPLETE column O
calibration.rule: Recalibrate only when new actual months are added; do not tune to future months.
calibration.note: FCST COMPLETE currently uses 1.0023936623, while the dedicated CALIBRATION sheet and the presentation describe approximately 1.00584.

seasonality.rule: Seasonality changes monthly shape without changing the KI total. Historical MoM shape is separate from dynamic forecast momentum to prevent recursive double counting.

reverse_calculator.logic: Select an annual KI total, normalize the KI seasonality profile to weights summing to 1, then reverse-calculate monthly market. In the live app, closed actual months are locked and only the remaining KI target is distributed over future months.

affordability.logic: Representative CUB basket / salary. Price rising faster than salary worsens affordability; salary rising faster than price improves it.

saturation.rule: UIO is carried by cohorts with mortality. PR is a forward structural control, not a monthly demand substitute.

event_controls.note: Political factors are temporary scenario assumptions, not facts.

imports_reference.governance: Imports are a supply/availability leading indicator. Never add imports to registrations and never treat them as demand one-for-one.
imports_reference.forecast_use: Use import contraction/acceleration as a scenario trigger only when confirmed by stock, registrations and model-level conversion.
